## Problem Description

A clear description of the problem or limitation you're experiencing.

**Example**: "When dumping large binaries, I have no way to see progress percentage or estimated time remaining."

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered and why they wouldn't work as well.

## Use Case

Explain the specific use case or workflow that would benefit from this feature.

## Mockups / Examples

If applicable, add mockups, sketches, or references from other apps that illustrate your idea.

## Component

Which part of the app does this relate to?
- [ ] Home Screen / Dump Interface
- [ ] Job History
- [ ] Job Detail / Export
- [ ] Native C++ Core (dumping logic)
- [ ] Configuration Options
- [ ] UI/UX (theming, navigation)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other: ___

## Additional Context

Add any other context about the feature request here.
